weaknesses.title: LOOKUPN treats non-numeric values as 0 with OK=1
weaknesses.detail: api:abc LOOKUPN → LAST_N=0 LOOKUPN_V=0 OK=1 (hit not miss). Agents cannot distinguish missing, zero, and garbage without dual LOOKUP string check.

weaknesses.title: LOOKUPN OR still OK=1 on miss
weaknesses.detail: Same silent-default class as LOOKUP OR. LOOKUPN_OR must be inspected; OK alone is insufficient for present-vs-default.
weaknesses.repro: LOOKUPN bag ghost OR 0 → OK=1 OR=1

weaknesses.title: THRESHKV drops non-numeric via strtol 0 without signal
weaknesses.detail: api:abc with min=1 is dropped as value 0; no THRESHKV_SKIP nonnum counter. Metadata keys vanish from HOT plate silently.

weaknesses.title: THRESHKV only >= min, no upper bound / range form
weaknesses.detail: Want KEEPVAL between lo..hi for SLO bands; only min. Agents need second pass or EACH filter.

weaknesses.title: No THRESHKV max / DROPVAL above form
weaknesses.detail: Cap outliers for burn ratio; only KEEPVAL >= min. MEANINGFUL_ITER candidate.

weaknesses.title: sep still string-literal only on LOOKUPN/THRESHKV
weaknesses.detail: Same family footgun as prior KV ops.

workarounds: After LOOKUPN check LOOKUPN_OR; dual LOOKUP string if value must be numeric
Inspect THRESHKV_DROP vs expected; validate values before thresh
Budget: CMP val_n CEIL with LAST_N>=0 as burned (>=)
language_gaps: LOOKUPN OR with OK=0 option on default
issues_faced: LOOKUPN non-numeric → 0 hit is high-sev footgun for SLO math
CMP LAST_N -1|0|1 works well for budget gate
